newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's ENI expects higher 1997 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Italy's ENI expects higher 1997 net profit.

text.p: Italian state-controlled energy group ENI expects its net profit to be higher than 1996, the prospectus for a third tranche of its privatisation said.

"As far as ENI Spa is concerned the forecasts for the result of Agip Spa and the bigger dividends expected from other companies following positive results in 1996 mean from the current position we can expect a further improvement of the net profit in 1997," said the prospectus, which was made available at a shareholders' meeting.

ENI said: "We forecast that cash flows will be enough to sustain investment needs and for distribution of dividends as well as further improving the ratio between net financial debt and net equity which was 0.57 at the end of 1996."
In the first quarter of 1997 orders for the engineering and services sector totalled 1.642 trillion lire compared with 1.144 trillion in the first quarter of 1996.
For 1997 the programme for technical investment envisages spending of around 8.4 trillion lire, up 8.5 percent on 1996 and concentrated principally on oil and natural gas activities.
